test_title: PYST 49 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 30 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Which sentence contains a misspelled word?

options.text: The professor's detailed critique helped the student improve his final draft.
The film received a thoughtful critiqe from several renowned reviewers.
She asked her peers to critique her presentation before the big conference.
An honest critique is essential for personal and professional growth.

solution:
The correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence in option 2 contains the misspelled word **"critiqe"**.
 
• The correct spelling is **"critique"**, which refers to a detailed analysis or assessment of something.
 
• In all other options, the word "critique" is spelled correctly.

Correct sentence: *The film received a thoughtful critique from several renowned reviewers.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Definition of "Critique":** A detailed analysis or assessment of something, especially a literary, philosophical, or political theory.
 
• **Examples:**
 
 
• The professor’s critique of the research paper was insightful.
 
• An honest critique helps to improve one’s work.
 
 
 
• **Synonyms:** Review, analysis, assessment, evaluation.
